Who we are

A philanthropic response to a public health call

Fankyenebra Hospital Foundation (FHF) was formed in May 2018 by Ghanaian social workers and advocates, and formally incorporated in October 2019 as a company limited by guarantee. We exist to support government efforts on Maternal, Neonatal and Child Health, at a moment when Ghana has called on partners, civil society and the private sector to help close the gap in care.

We work so that women in our operational area have access to skilled birth attendants through pregnancy, birth and the postpartum period — and so that newborns and children under five are nourished, protected from infection, and properly treated when they fall ill.

Our mission

Equitable, quality maternal and child healthcare for the communities we serve.

Our vision

To pioneer safe, healthy outcomes for every pregnant woman and child.

Our values

Integrity, transparency, confidentiality and non-discrimination.

Our goal

Cut maternal and child deaths in Kumasi Metropolis by 50% by 2030.

Learn about our foundation

Our programmes

A continuum of care, from pregnancy through infancy

Our work concentrates on the window where risk is highest — pregnancy and a baby's first year — through four linked stages of support.

Stage 01

Antenatal care

Regular check-ups and health education through pregnancy, catching risks early.

Enquire
Stage 02

Skilled birth attendance

Trained attendants present at delivery, backed by stronger referral pathways for complications.

Enquire
Stage 03

Postnatal care

Follow-up support for mother and baby through the vulnerable weeks after birth.

Enquire
Stage 04

Infant care

Nutrition, protection from infection, and treatment of common childhood illness through age five.

Enquire
